Beauvoir

Candidate for Beauvoir's 'to will oneself free is to will others free' (our weak reading): a move closes off no form open to the self iff it breaks no shared future with any other state; content is coherence and fails without binary conflict (open_each_not_whole). Negative: a join never adds an open form (open_join_iff), so 'the other enlarges my freedom' is not obtained

Lacan's Borromean knot computed as a link, in exact integer arithmetic. Three-ellipse Borromean rings: every linking number 0 and Milnor's triple number mu(RSI) = mu(SIR) = mu(IRS) = -1, by two independent methods (Magnus expansion of the longitudes; Seifert-disc triple point). Any single R-S crossing change (16 cases): lk(R,S) = +-1 and I unlinked from both. Bing double of one ring, four rings R,S,I,Sigma: every lk = 0, every mu(ijk) = 0, mu(RSI;Sigma) = +1, so each three-ring sublink is link-homotopically trivial and the four rings cannot be separated. Trefoil: 9 Fox 3-colourings against 3. Facts about links only; not a clinical claim.

Causal-set side: on a Fisher frame Beauvoir.Barbarian is exactly 'no common future' (barbarian_iff_beyond), which is inherited upward in any partial order (beyond_mono); in N x N spacelike points meet, so the light-cone lattice is not a Fisher frame (lightcone_not_frame). Small; overlaps Unify.permanence_iff_no_reconciliation

Pure two-party state, any finite dimensions: S(A)=S(B) (entropy_symm), equal moments and Schmidt rank, and reduced state pure iff product (pure_iff_product, via the Lagrange identity sum_minor_sq). Three parties: a pure pair leaves the third uncorrelated (monogamy_of_pure_pair); GHZ pair state is separable. Matrix facts; the self/other reading is interpretation

Fisher, hauntology as branching time: lost futures accumulate (lost_mono), haunting is monotone (haunted_mono), a branch point haunts (haunted_of_branch), capitalist_realism; models only cancelled possibility, no claim about Fisher.

States of an event structure with binary conflict (Nielsen-Plotkin-Winskel; textbook facts): a loss between states is permanent iff they clash, else undone at the union; a clashing branch has a greatest part that can still be joined (salvage); the states are a Fisher frame iff no two forms are concurrent

Not proved: the Coffman-Kundu-Wootters inequality (needs mixed-state concurrence), min-cut = entanglement entropy for HaPPY states, contraction of a general tensor network to the factorised form. Not fitting: symmetric entropy cannot tell recognition from domination; a partial trace is not a death; barbarian-as-spacelike is not permanent in a causal set with diamonds

Tree against rhizome over all 33,867 labelled graphs on at most 6 vertices: a connected graph is a tree iff every edge is a bridge; adding one edge to a tree frees exactly the edges of the cycle it closes; connected bridgeless graphs number 1, 0, 1, 10, 253, 11968 for 1..6 vertices.

Renames: monogamy_of_pure_pair is now pure_pair_decouples (decoupling of a pure pair, not CKW monogamy); rt_monogamy is now rt_mmi (monogamy of mutual information, not CKW); schmidt_rank_le_cut is now schmidt_rank_le_bond_pow (E is an index type, no graph cut; entropy <= log rank not proved). barbarian_iff_beyond is a definitional alias of Beauvoir.barbarian_iff_no_common_future; causal_order_from_links is Mathlib lt_iff_transGen_covBy; bell_bond_saturates is identity has full rank. no_network_has_ghz_entropies rules out the four-party GHZ pattern only; the three-party GHZ pattern is realised by a star graph

Levels as a projection: 'some preimage has S' and 'every preimage has S' agree for all S iff the projection is injective (collapse_iff_injective); for the finite-table-to-Phi projection at n=2 they differ for some S (level_gap, from P3's virtualOf_not_injective). Formal analogy only

Fisher frame after the review renames (supersedes 66145862, whose evidence cites the old name capitalist_realism): lost_mono, haunted_mono, haunted_of_branch, no_alternative_of_all_reachable. General order facts, read as hauntology (a cited reading).
Model of a cited Deleuze reading: distinct problems share actual solutions; nondegenerate singular points are isolated (inverse function theorem)

Formal analogy (no claim about Deleuze): finite slack table is the actual, Phi the virtual; Phi does not determine the slack table (PhiT_not_injective) and the corners Phi(0), Phi(1) do not determine Phi (corners_not_injective); limit level is a def only

One frame (models of cited readings, no claim about the authors or circuits): in a tree of decisions a lost route is at once Fisher-lost for ever, Hegel-determinate (one definite point of difference), the trace of a Beauvoir-free moment, the present's barbarian with no common moment, and lost along every Camus ascent (unified); in any partial order loss is permanent iff lost pairs never meet again (permanence_iff_no_reconciliation)

DAG frame (order theory, readings ours): in any partial order a lost future is later either still lost or part of the past, never ahead again (lost_or_past); a loss is permanent iff the two have no common later state (lost_forever_iff_apart)

Not found: a theorem for Beauvoir's 'to will oneself free is to will others free' (a tree frame has no shared future for incomparable selves; a frame with joins loses lost_mono), a model of master and slave beyond non-recognition, and Lawvere's adjoint cylinder between the repository's levels. No text by Beauvoir titled 'The Barbarians' found; the word is Barres's, in her 1926 diary (search summaries only)
